name: Hinge
description: Hinge is a dating app built around profile cards on the Discover tab and messages on the Matches tab. Main flow: Discover tab displays profile cards as vertical scrollers to explore and like photos/videos/prompts with comments; Matches tab displays conversations divided into collapsible sections to check and reply to incoming messages. Discover can run dry and show a 'You've seen everyone for now' end state; Matches can be empty and show a 'No matches right now' end state.

workflows.name: browse_discover_profiles
workflows.steps: Open the app and tap 'Discover' in the bottom nav. For each new profile card, mandatory anti-bot exploration: first fling to the end of the profile in one action via scroll_to_edge with direction='down' on the profile scroller (#2 [Scroller]). Never skip this down-fling (skipping triggers anti-bot detection and shadowbans). Then immediately use workflow fast_scroll_to_top_photo to return to the head of the card. To advance to the next profile without liking, tap 'Skip <name>' (X icon) at bottom-left. An 'Undo last skip' control appears after skipping if you need to reverse it. If a 'Review skipped profiles' dialog or banner appears, ignore or dismiss it without tapping it. When the Discover deck is exhausted, it shows 'You've seen everyone for now' with 'Change filters' and 'Review skipped profiles' buttons -- this is a normal terminal end state; do not tap either button or scroll, just finish the pass.

workflows.name: fast_scroll_to_top_photo
workflows.steps: To return to the first photo of a profile in one action, use scroll_to_edge with direction='up' on the profile scroller (#2 [Scroller]). Then CONFIRM you arrived: the profile's name (e.g. [Text] 'Alex') at top-left is listed only at the head of the card. Pronouns appear under the name in several spellings ('she/her', 'they/them', 'she', 'her/she', 'she/her/hers') on some profiles but not all -- the name header alone plus a confirmed top-fling is sufficient. If the name is missing from the element list, you are still mid-profile or at the bottom: repeat scroll_to_edge up. A single up-fling does not always reach the top; repeatedly it takes an up-fling plus a confirming tap on the card before the full header appears. Only proceed to like once the header is confirmed.

workflows.name: like_photo_or_prompt_with_comment
workflows.steps: PRECONDITION: The element list confirms the profile name at top-left, i.e. scrolled to its first photo. Without that header, do not tap any heart. On Discover, tap the TOPMOST like button (@top-right before @bottom-right) -- that is the first card's heart ('Like photo', 'Like video', 'Like prompt', or 'Like photo prompt'). The lower heart belongs to the card below and likes the wrong photo. A comment composer sheet opens. Type comment via input_text into 'Edit comment' (if element list only lists #1 [Scroller], target 'Edit comment' specifically to focus the text field) with confidence='low' (forces a screenshot turn on the next step). Pre-Send Image Analysis Verification: check the next turn to verify (a) the comment text is visually in the field, or the element list shows the send button transformed to 'Send priority like with message', and (b) the composer's media carries a '1/N' badge if one is shown. If the comment box is empty, do NOT tap Send: re-tap 'Edit comment' and re-type. FALLBACK when input_text keeps failing: set_clipboard with the comment, long_press 'Edit comment' to raise the Paste/Autofill popup, then tap 'Paste'. If a media badge is visible and does not read '1/', the wrong photo is loaded: press_key back followed by open_app co.hinge.app and restart the profile. Once confirmed, tap the send pill by its #N -- it is in the element list as 'Send priority like with message' once a comment is entered. Never tap 'Send a Rose' / 'Send a Rose with message' beside it (paid). Screenshot after tapping to verify composer closed = sent. If the screen goes blank white after tapping send, wait 2 seconds for UI recovery before relaunching. If the harness refuses the composer's send control 3+ times, abandon that like and move to the next profile.

workflows.name: view_messages_and_chats
workflows.steps: Tap 'Matches' (4th tab in bottom nav, badged with new-message count) to access conversations. COLLAPSIBLE SECTION STATE: The conversation list is divided into collapsible sections: 'Your turn (N)' (matches waiting for your reply), 'Their turn', and 'Hidden (N)'. Check whether 'Your turn' is collapsed (downward chevron or no conversation elements directly below it): if collapsed, tap 'Your turn' to expand it before inspecting any chat. If 'Their turn' or 'Hidden' is expanded (upward chevron), tap their headers to collapse them so that their conversations are hidden and cannot be accidentally tapped. STRICT PROHIBITION: ONLY open and process conversations located strictly under 'Your turn'; completely skip 'Their turn' and 'Hidden'. When there are no active matches, the tab shows 'No matches right now' with a 'Boost your profile' button and a collapsed 'Hidden (N)' section -- do not tap 'Boost your profile' (paid), just finish the reply check. Chat thread layout: The top photo card displaying an initial comment banner ('Hey 🔥' / 'Your Priority Like helped you stand out') is your initial outgoing comment from discovery, NOT an incoming reply. Incoming messages appear as white bubbles on the left below the photo card; outgoing messages appear as purple bubbles on the right followed by status indicator [Button] 'Sent'. If no incoming bubble from the match is present or the last message in thread was sent by you, send nothing and tap 'Back' (top-left chevron) to return to Matches. If replying per policy, type into 'Send a message' (id=messageComposition) with confidence='low' to trigger a screenshot verification turn before tapping Send. Do not tap 'Record voice note' beside the input field. Leftover draft cleanup: If messageComposition contains leftover text in a chat where no reply should be sent, clear it with empty input_text before leaving. Leave chats using the 'Back' chevron at top-left; avoid press_key back from the Matches list as it can open the top chat.

nuances: When opening the Matches tab, 'Your turn' can be collapsed by default (downward chevron) while 'Their turn' is expanded (upward chevron). Always check the header chevron and tap 'Your turn' to expand it, and tap 'Their turn' to collapse it before interacting with any chat.

A chat row under Matches is only genuinely under 'Your turn' if its vertical position sits between 'Your turn' and 'Their turn'. Elements below 'Their turn' belong to other sections and must not be opened.
press_key back does NOT dismiss the like-comment composer; it exits to launcher from Discover. Use the bottom nav bar for all navigation.
Scrolling down on Discover reveals more of the SAME profile; only tapping 'Skip <name>' (X icon) advances to the next profile.

A scroll-down pass over a profile ENDS AT ITS BOTTOM, on the last photo. The up-scroll back to the first photo is a separate action and is mandatory before liking: in runs/9b9c69095095 it was skipped for profile 'S' and the like landed on the profile's last photo while the step reported 'at the first photo'.

The profile's name and pronouns appear as separate top-left text elements (e.g. 'Alex', 'she/her') ONLY when the profile is scrolled to its first photo. Their absence from the element list is the reliable signal that you are mid-profile or at the bottom -- at the bottom of 'S' the list held only 'Selfie Verified' and two 'Like photo' buttons.

The like composer shows the media being liked, and Hinge draws a '1/N' badge on a profile's first photo (observed: '1/4' in the composer for a first photo, no badge in the composer for a last photo). A visible badge that does not read '1/' means the wrong photo is loaded.

When typing in the like-comment composer, if the element list only shows #1 [Scroller], target 'Edit comment' specifically so focus lands on the text field rather than empty space in the scroller center.
Pre-Send Verification is mandatory: Never tap Send if the visual analysis or screenshot shows an empty comment box. If empty, re-tap 'Edit comment' and re-type the comment.
Do not guess x/y fractions for the send pill: it is listed, so tap it by #N.
If the screen goes blank white after tapping send, wait 2 seconds for UI recovery before relaunching.

Inside a chat thread, outgoing messages appear as purple bubbles on the right and display a 'Sent' status indicator ([Button] 'Sent') at bottom-right below the bubble. Incoming messages appear as white bubbles on the left. The reply field is labelled 'Send a message' and sits beside a 'Record voice note' button -- do not tap the voice note button.

The like-comment composer has Android FLAG_SECURE enabled; adbagent now automatically captures full-color frames via emulator host window fallback. Once the comment 'Hey 🔥' is typed, the send button changes to 'Send priority like with message' in the element list. If the button already reads 'with message', the text is entered; do not re-type.

press_key back from the Matches conversation list can land INSIDE the top chat thread instead of leaving the tab (observed: back from Matches list opened the 'Your turn' chat). To leave Matches, tap a bottom-nav tab, not back.
The comment field in the like composer is labelled 'Edit comment' in the element list but shows placeholder 'Add a comment' on screen -- same field.
Paid-upsell controls (Boost, Roses, HingeX, Signals) appear on various screens; do not tap them. 'Send a Rose' sits beside the send pill in the composer -- never tap it.

When the Discover deck is exhausted, the screen shows 'You've seen everyone for now' with 'Change filters' and 'Review skipped profiles'. This is a terminal state for the pass -- do not tap either button or keep scrolling.

Inside a chat thread the header shows the match's name with a 'Verified' badge, a 'Back' chevron at top-left, a 'More' (three-dot) menu at top-right, and 'Chat' / 'Profile' tabs below the name. Use the 'Back' chevron to return to the Matches list; do not tap 'More' or 'Profile' unless the task requires it.

The profile's name appears as a top-left text element ONLY when the profile is scrolled to its first photo. Pronouns ('she/her') usually appear under it but are NOT rendered for every profile -- one profile showed the name with no pronouns even after the scroller confirmed 'flung to the top'. Treat name-present + confirmed top-fling as sufficient; do not keep re-flinging for missing pronouns.
After a successful like send, Discover advances to the next profile on its own; the new card may initially show the name without pronouns -- that is the new profile loading, not a failed send.

Several like buttons are listed at once, one per card visible on screen, and their labels repeat ('Like photo', 'Like video', 'Like prompt'). The first card's heart is the TOPMOST: prefer @top-right over @bottom-right. Tapping the lower one likes the card below it.

In the like-comment composer the send pill IS in the element list: 'Send priority like' before a comment is typed, 'Send priority like with message' after. Tap it by #N; do not guess x/y fractions. 'Send a Rose' beside it is a paid feature -- never tap it.

A first input_text into the composer can silently fail -- observed repeatedly across profiles: the field still shows placeholder 'Add a comment' with the keyboard up and the button still 'Send priority like' after input_text. Always verify the field content (or the 'with message' button label) on the next turn; if empty, re-tap 'Edit comment' and re-type. Never tap Send on an empty box.

scroll_to_edge up does not always reach the top in one fling: observed cases where after one up-fling the element list had no name header, and another where the name was present but pronouns were not. Repeat the up-fling (a confirming tap on the card can also settle it) until the name appears at top-left before liking.
Mid-profile scrolls can surface a stats strip (Age, Gender, Sexuality, Height, Location, Job, Religion) between photos -- seeing it means you are mid-profile, not at the top.
The Standouts tab shows profile cards whose only like control is 'Send a Rose' (with a rose count, e.g. '0 roses remaining') -- a paid feature. Do not like from Standouts; do all liking on Discover.

After restart_app, Hinge shows a splash/loading screen (H logo on Discover) before the profile card redraws; wait for it rather than tapping during the load. The Discover element list can also come back with only the 'Discover' title and bottom nav (no scroller) -- wait or tap the Discover tab again rather than acting on the empty list.

A chat thread can interleave the match's photo cards between messages (a photo with your like comment attached appears inline in the thread, sometimes with a 'Your Priority Like helped you stand out / Tap to dismiss' banner). Do not mistake these inline photos for a new profile to like.

Profiles can contain video cards: the element list then shows '<name>'s video', 'Like video', and an 'Unmute video' control. 'Like video' works exactly like 'Like photo' -- it opens the same comment composer. Do not tap 'Unmute video' unless needed. Video prompt cards appear as 'Video prompt: <title>' with an 'Elapsed time: N seconds' element.

Tapping the Gboard suggestion strip chip (e.g. 'Hey 🔥' at roughly (0.80,0.77)) does NOT reliably enter text into the composer -- observed multiple times leaving the 'Add a comment' field empty. Use input_text on 'Edit comment' instead; the suggestion strip is not a substitute.

Taps fail verification at a noticeable rate in this app (20 failures vs 119 passes across recent runs; scroll_to_edge down failed 7 of 36). After any consequential tap (send pill, tab switch, Skip), confirm the expected screen change on the next observation before proceeding; re-issue the tap if nothing changed.

The harness can refuse the composer's send control repeatedly (same control refused 3+ times in a row, observed across several profiles in one pass). Retrying the same send tap, press_key back, or restart_app does not reliably clear it. When this happens, abandon that like and move on (skip to the next profile or end the pass) instead of burning steps.

The Matches badge count can be stale: it kept showing '1 new message' across a whole pass even after the only 'Your turn' chat had been opened and inspected. Do not treat the badge alone as proof of an unhandled message -- re-check the 'Your turn' list contents, and do not loop re-opening the same already-handled chat just because the badge persists.

A previously skipped profile can reappear in Discover with a 'Take another look' label and 'Profile pictures of you and <name>.' text instead of the usual header -- it is a normal card; like or skip it with the same rules.
Prompt cards that pair a photo with a prompt show the like control as 'Like photo prompt' -- it opens the same comment composer as 'Like photo'.

Pronouns render in several spellings depending on the profile: 'she/her', 'she', 'her/she', 'she/her/hers', 'they/them'. Any of them under the name confirms the header; none of them is guaranteed to appear.

When there are no active matches, the Matches tab shows 'No matches right now' with a 'Boost your profile' button and only a collapsed 'Hidden (N)' section. This is a terminal empty state for the reply check -- do not tap 'Boost your profile' (paid upsell) and do not expand Hidden.

The exhausted-Discover screen still shows the filter chips row at top ('Signals', 'Age', 'Height', 'Dating Intentions', 'Active today', sometimes 'New here') and the full bottom nav (Discover, Standouts, Likes You, Matches, Profile Hub) -- the Matches badge count is readable there, so you can check for new messages without leaving Discover first.

When input_text and field taps repeatedly fail to land text in the composer, the clipboard route works: set_clipboard with the comment, long_press the 'Edit comment' field to raise the Paste/Autofill popup, then tap 'Paste'. Observed to fill the field (button flipped to 'Send priority like with message') after multiple input_text attempts had failed. Note the Paste/Autofill popup can persist over the photo -- tap 'Paste' by its element, not blindly.
Some photo and video cards carry a 'Show caption' control; it only expands a caption and is not needed for liking -- do not tap it.
recommendations: Matches tab: Always check if 'Your turn' is collapsed; tap it to expand it, and tap 'Their turn' / 'Hidden' to collapse them before inspecting chats.
Fast return to 1st photo: use scroll_to_edge with direction='up' on the profile scroller -- one action, and it cannot stop short.

Before every like, check the element list for the profile name + pronouns at top-left. That check is cheap, it is the only evidence that you are on the first photo, and a like is irreversible -- an observation saying 'at the first photo' is not evidence.
Fast profile exploration: use scroll_to_edge with direction='down' to reach the end of a profile in one action.

To send a like comment or reply: type text via input_text into 'Edit comment' (composer) or 'Send a message' (chat) with confidence='low', inspect the resulting image analysis or element list (confirm 'Send priority like with message') before sending. Then tap the send control by its #N (it is in the element list) and confirm the composer closed.
In the composer, if 'Send priority like with message' is present, the comment is loaded. Do not repeat input_text if the button already confirms the message is attached.
Use bottom nav (Discover, Matches) for navigation; avoid press_key back inside Hinge -- from the Matches list it can drop you into a chat thread.
When Discover shows 'You've seen everyone for now', stop liking for the pass and leave the phone on the Discover or Matches list -- never inside a profile or a chat.

Fast return to 1st photo: use scroll_to_edge with direction='up' on the profile scroller, and be prepared to issue it twice -- verify with the name header (plus pronouns if the profile renders them), not with the action's success.
Video cards are likeable via 'Like video' with the same composer flow as photos; the same first-card and comment-verification rules apply.

Check Matches before working Discover each pass; only open chats under 'Your turn', and even then reply only when policy requires it based on the newest incoming message. If the only 'Your turn' chat was already inspected and needs no reply, do not keep re-opening it when the badge persists.

If the harness refuses the composer's send control 3+ times on one profile, give up on that like: leave the composer (restart_app if back will not dismiss it), and continue with the next profile or end the pass. Do not spend more steps retrying the same send.

Conversations: Only open chats listed under 'Your turn'. Never tap or message chats under 'Their turn' or 'Hidden'. In chat, verify the bottom-most bubble is an incoming message from the match (not an outgoing purple bubble or one followed by 'Sent') before drafting a reply. If Matches shows 'No matches right now', the reply check is done -- move on without tapping 'Boost your profile'.

If input_text into the composer fails twice in a row, switch to the clipboard route: set_clipboard, long_press 'Edit comment', tap 'Paste' in the popup, then verify the 'with message' button label before sending.

Treat all paid features (Boost, Roses, HingeX, Signals) as off-limits, including the Standouts tab where 'Send a Rose' is the only like option and the 'Boost your profile' button on the empty Matches screen.
